title: WhyNoIPv6 — Rank-Weighted Adoption
description: Does the web that matters adopt IPv6? Adoption by Tranco rank band, the top-1000 trend, and the highest-ranked offenders.

panels.title: Top-1000 web IPv6
panels.description: Tranco top-1000 domains with web-facing IPv6 (stats_global_daily.top_heroes, latest snapshot). The number journalists would quote.

targets.rawSql: SELECT top_heroes / 10.0 AS pct FROM stats_global_daily WHERE top_heroes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Top-1000 v6 nameservers
panels.description: Tranco top-1000 domains whose DNS is served over IPv6 (stats_global_daily.top_nameserver, latest snapshot).

targets.rawSql: SELECT top_nameserver / 10.0 AS pct FROM stats_global_daily WHERE top_nameserver IS NOT NULL ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Ranked domains
panels.description: Active domains carrying a Tranco rank (the rest are subdomains, campaign extras, or delist-grace rows).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS ranked FROM domain WHERE rank IS NOT NULL AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Top-100 sinners
panels.description: Domains in the Tranco top 100 with confirmed no IPv6 at all. Every one of these is a headline.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS sinners FROM domain WHERE rank <= 100 AND classification = 'sinner' AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Apex IPv6 adoption by rank band (cumulative top-N)
panels.description: Share of confirmed apexes publishing AAAA within each cumulative Tranco band. If the top of the web leads, the bars descend.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 100 AND base_status = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 100 AND base_status IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "top 100", count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 1000 AND base_status = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 1000 AND base_status IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "top 1k", count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 10000 AND base_status = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 10000 AND base_status IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "top 10k", count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 100000 AND base_status = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 100000 AND base_status IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "top 100k", count(*) FILTER (WHERE base_status = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE base_status IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "top 1M" FROM domain WHERE rank IS NOT NULL AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Hero share by rank band
panels.description: Full-stack IPv6 (hero classification) share per cumulative band — the stricter bar than apex AAAA alone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 100 AND classification = 'hero')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 100), 0) AS "top 100", count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 1000 AND classification = 'hero')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 1000), 0) AS "top 1k", count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 10000 AND classification = 'hero')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 10000), 0) AS "top 10k", count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 100000 AND classification = 'hero')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank <= 100000), 0) AS "top 100k", count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification = 'hero')::float / count(*) AS "top 1M" FROM domain WHERE rank IS NOT NULL AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Top-1000 adoption over time
panels.description: top_heroes / top_nameserver from the daily snapshots, as a share of 1000.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, top_heroes / 10.0 AS "web v6 %", top_nameserver / 10.0 AS "ns v6 %" FROM stats_global_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Highest-ranked sinners
panels.description: The most prominent domains with confirmed zero IPv6 — the shame list, ordered by importance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT rank, host FROM domain WHERE classification = 'sinner' AND rank IS NOT NULL AND NOT disabled ORDER BY rank LIMIT 25

panels.title: Editorial top shame
panels.description: Hand-picked offenders from v6ctl shame add — the curated wall of shame.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.rank, d.host, t.reason FROM top_shame t JOIN domain d ON d.id = t.domain_id ORDER BY d.rank NULLS LAST LIMIT 25
